summary: BifrOSt has a system thumbnails service with providers for images, text, PDF, audio and video (cover, poster frame, waveform card and a running time badge), archives, fonts and documents, a shared disk cache, an app extension point ([[preview]] with preview.render, with the system provider as the fallback), an SDK generator with tier updates and cancel, and thumbnails in Files, the Space panel and Spotlight file rows. Apple's error codes are not matched, and Desktop icons and the Dock do not show thumbnails yet.

features.feature: Thumbnail request by size and scale (generateBestRepresentation)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/thumbnails.rs (request, reply, ThumbRequest and edge_px re-exported from bifrost_ui::thumb_service); springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01d.rs
features.note: A request names a path, a size in points, a scale and a kind, and is validated (BadPath, BadSize); the answer (pending, pixels, icon or failed) decodes headless (thumbnail_edges_scale_and_clamp_to_the_pixel_limits, a_thumbnail_request_needs_an_absolute_clean_path_and_a_sane_size, thumbnail_answers_decode_into_their_states). 2026-10-19: the completion side is built as ThumbnailGenerator (sdk/src/thumbnail_generator.rs): generate(ctx, GeneratorRequest) returns an id, accept(reply) routes the service's reply or ready/failed event to the generation that asked for that file and edge, and failures carry a ThumbnailError code; cancel(id) stops a generation (tests in thumbnail_generator.rs). The cache is shared by the shell (see the cache row), so no cache object is needed in the app. Midget check: in a test app, call ThumbnailGenerator::generate on a PNG and a PDF from service_reply and service_event, and see an icon update, then the picture; `cargo test -p bifrost-app thumbnail_generator`.

features.note: 2026-10-19, corrected: the tiers are planned by the client, so the service needs no per-tier parameter (the earlier note said the service did not read the types). One model now (bifrost_ui::thumb_service::RepresentationType; the shell and SDK copies were merged, which also fixed a disagreement: the SDK used half the edge for low quality, the shell a quarter). GeneratorRequest::plan sends the icon kind, a low quality request at a quarter of the edge (16 px floor) and the full size; ThumbnailGenerator delivers them cheapest first and never a worse one after a better one. Tests: thumb_service::tests::tiers_are_cheapest_first_deduplicated_and_the_low_tier_is_a_quarter, thumbnails::tests::the_plan_goes_icon_then_low_quality_then_full. The update handler is Generation (per-request tier tracking) plus ThumbnailGenerator (several generations at once, Update::Representation and Update::Failed, cancel, at most 256 running); the shell already answers a slow thumbnail as pending and then sends a ready or failed event to every asker. Tests in thumbnail_generator.rs (updates_run_icon_low_full_and_the_finished_generation_is_dropped, a_failure_reports_its_code_and_ends_that_generation_only, a_cancelled_generation_hears_nothing_more). features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/thumbnail_generator.rs (FileThumbnailRequest, ThumbnailReply, answer_provider_call); springboard/ui/src/preview_manifest.rs ([[preview]] blocks); springboard/src/shell/preview_gen.rs (Generators, Requests, Generator::distance); springboard/src/shell/services/thumbnails.rs (request, poll); springboard/ui/src/thumb_service.rs (Registry::distance_for)
features.note: 2026-10-19, corrected: the earlier note and its paths were stale (FileThumbnailRequest was not in sdk/thumbnails.rs). The extension point exists: an app declares [[preview]] (id, types, generator preview.render, timeout_ms) in manifest.toml and answers the control call with the PNG it drew; the thumbnails service asked such an app only for types no built-in provider draws. Built now: (1) the app side API (FileThumbnailRequest::parse validates file and size, ThumbnailReply::picture accepts only an absolute .png path, answer_provider_call dispatches and turns failures into error replies); (2) an app whose declared type is at least as specific as the system provider's is asked first for Files and Spotlight thumbnails, and a broad declaration such as public.data never overrides the system pictures; (3) when the app gives no picture in time the built-in provider draws the file (the askers keep waiting on the same key), else the icon. Tests: thumbnails::tests::an_app_that_declares_the_very_type_draws_it_before_the_system_provider, when_the_app_gives_no_picture_the_system_provider_draws_the_file, an_app_that_declares_only_a_broad_type_does_not_take_over_the_system_pictures; thumbnail_generator::tests (request, reply, dispatch). Notes already declares Markdown. Not built: replies carrying data or a drawing callback instead of a PNG path. Midget check: Notes declares [[preview]] for Markdown; put a .md file in a Files folder, icon view: the thumbnail is the note's first lines drawn by Notes (control call preview.render, `bifrost pc control call notes preview.render '{"file":"/path/a.md","width":128,"height":128}'`); with Notes stopped it is the text provider's page.

features.note: Domain 'bifrost.thumbnails' and five codes (bad request, no such file, unsupported, cancelled, failed). The code is read from the shell's failure message, and a refused request maps to bad request. Host unit tests only. The codes are BifrOSt's own: the reference codes could not be read from the official page here, so they are not matched. The shell still answers with a message only. built on parity/team-j-quick-look; not yet verified on Midget.

gaps: Provider extensions answer with a PNG path only; no data or drawing-callback replies
Thumbnails are not drawn for Desktop icons or Dock stacks
No Live Photo or USDZ thumbnails (no such files on the PC)
No app calls ThumbnailGenerator yet; Files asks the thumbnails service directly
